task: Analyze monolayer epitaxial graphene tr-ARPES data under 5 µm mid-IR pump to identify Floquet-Bloch replica Dirac cones and Volkov final-state scattering signatures.
named_inputs: processed_band_data.json extracted main and replica band positions/intensities
polarization_dependence_data.csv replica intensity vs pump polarization angle
methodological_commitments: time-resolved and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy feature analysis
energy- and momentum-resolved observation of Floquet-Bloch replica bands
polarization-angle dependence analysis for photon-dressed Volkov final-state scattering
comparison of main Dirac cone and replica band offsets/intensities
